articles.summary: Cyabra found that election fraud claims outpaced every other narrative in South Korea's June 3 election conversation, amplified by a coordinated layer of inauthentic accounts across X, Facebook, and Instagram.
articles.title: How a Ballot Shortage Fueled Election Fraud Claims in South Korea

articles.summary: Cyabra found inauthentic accounts moving between five boycotted retailers, clustering under high-reach posts and riding real users' hashtags to amplify the calls for boycott.
articles.title: Amazon, Home Depot, Starbucks: The Retail Boycott’s Most Manipulated Brands
